props.heading: Spaces that feel like they were always meant to be yours
props.sub: Architecture, interior design and project management for homes and commercial spaces. Based in Bengaluru, working across India.

props.label: Our Firm
props.heading: Designing homes that breathe, since 2012
props.body:
Studio A&D was founded by architect Arjun Mehta with a straightforward mission: design spaces that are beautiful, functional and honest.

We are a team of twelve architects, interior designers, furniture designers and project managers. Every project — from a single-room renovation to a full-home build — is led by a principal designer who stays with it from the first site visit through to the final walkthrough.

We do not believe in style labels. A contemporary living room, a minimal bedroom and a classic entrance hall can coexist in the same home because they serve different purposes. Our job is to understand how you actually live and design around that, not around a mood board.

Our work has been featured in Architectural Digest India, Elle Decor and Living Etc. We have won twelve design awards and completed over 250 projects across nine states.

props.label: Design Packages
props.heading: Choose your scope
props.sub: All packages include a site visit, design brief, mood boards and material samples. Prices are all-inclusive with no hidden fees.

items.title: Essential Design
items.desc: Professional space planning and a curated design concept for a single room. Ideal for homeowners who want a clear design direction and need help making confident choices.
items.body:
The Essential package is perfect for a focused room makeover. You get a professional designer who visits your space, understands how you use it, and puts together a complete design concept with material samples and a shopping list.

What is included:
• One site visit and detailed measurements
• Design brief and mood board presentation
• Space plan with furniture layout
• Material and finish recommendations
• Colour palette and lighting plan
• Shopping list with budget estimates
• One revision round on the design concept

Delivery: Design concept within 4 weeks of the site visit. The plan can be executed with your own contractor or with our project management team (quoted separately).

This package suits living rooms, bedrooms and home offices. For kitchens and bathrooms, please see the Premier package which includes detailed joinery drawings.

items.title: Premier Design
items.desc: Complete interior design for one or two rooms with detailed drawings, 3D renders and vendor coordination. Our most popular choice for full room transformations.
items.body:
The Premier package is built for clients who want a complete room transformation without managing multiple vendors. A senior designer handles everything from the concept through to installation.

What is included:
• One site visit and detailed measurements
• Two design concepts to choose from
• Detailed joinery and elevation drawings
• Photorealistic 3D renders of the final design
• Full material palette with physical samples
• Custom furniture design (up to 3 pieces)
• Vendor coordination and procurement support
• Two revision rounds on the design
• One site visit during execution for quality check

Delivery: Design within 4 weeks, project completion within 10 weeks depending on scope.

The Premier package is ideal for living rooms, master bedrooms, kitchens and dining areas. The scope includes coordination with carpenters, painters and electricians through to installation.

items.title: Luxury Design
items.desc: Full-home interior design with custom furniture, art curation and turnkey execution. For clients who want a completely cohesive home without lifting a finger.
items.body:
The Luxury package is our most comprehensive offering — a full-home interior design and turnkey execution service that covers every room, every detail and every vendor.

A principal designer leads a dedicated team of junior designers, a furniture designer and a project coordinator. You approve the concept once, and we handle everything else.

What is included:
• Multiple site visits and full property survey
• Three complete design concepts for client selection
• Full set of architectural and interior working drawings
• Photorealistic 3D renders and VR walkthrough
• Custom furniture design for every room
• Art and decor curation including sourcing
• Full procurement and vendor management
• Dedicated project manager on site during execution
• Weekly progress reports with photographs
• Final walkthrough and handover documentation

Delivery: Concept design within 6 weeks. Project completion within 4–6 months depending on the size of the home.

The Luxury package is best suited for 3BHK and larger apartments, independent homes and villas. It covers all rooms including living, dining, kitchen, bedrooms, bathrooms, balconies and common areas.

items.a: We follow a five-stage process: Discovery (site visit and brief), Concept (mood boards and space plan), Design (detailed drawings and 3D renders), Execution (procurement and installation), and Handover (final walkthrough and styling). Every stage is presented to you for approval before we move to the next.

items.q: How much do you charge, and what is included?
items.a: Our packaged services start at ₹49,999 for the Essential Design (single room) and go up to ₹4,99,999 for the Luxury Design (full home). All packages include site visits, design concepts, material samples and a clear deliverable list. The Premier and Luxury packages include vendor coordination and project management. There are no hidden fees — every quote is itemised.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: An Essential Design concept is delivered within 4 weeks. Premier designs take 4 weeks for the concept and 8–10 weeks for full execution. Luxury projects take 6 weeks for the concept and 4–6 months for complete turnkey delivery. These are commitments based on a decade of project data — not optimistic estimates.

items.q: Do you work with existing furniture and decor?
items.a: Absolutely. We always ask what pieces you want to keep before designing anything new. Our designs incorporate existing furniture, heirlooms and artwork so your home feels like yours — not a catalogue. This also helps reduce waste and keeps the budget in check.

items.q: Can you handle structural changes and renovations?
items.a: Yes. We regularly work on renovations that involve removing or adding walls, changing window openings, redoing flooring and updating electrical and plumbing layouts. Our team includes architects who can assess structural feasibility and coordinate with structural engineers where needed.

items.q: Do you manage contractors and vendors?
items.a: Premier and Luxury packages include full vendor coordination. We work with a curated network of carpenters, painters, electricians, plumbers and custom fabricators that we have vetted over many projects. For Essential clients, we provide a list of reliable contractors and can supervise installation at an additional fee.

items.q: Can we visit a completed project before booking?
items.a: We are happy to arrange a visit to a completed project that matches the scope you are considering — subject to the homeowner's consent. Alternatively, we can schedule a video call with a past client who has agreed to share their experience. Just let us know what would help you feel confident.
